**What you'd like**
A clear description of the feature.

**Why**
The problem it solves or the question it answers.

**Fit with scope**
Have a look at [SPEC.md](../../SPEC.md) §2 and §9 first. Individual life expectancy, years-remaining, or countdown features are out of scope by design and will be declined — the app is a cohort tool, not a death clock.

**Alternatives considered**
Anything else you thought about.
